title: Why Christ is said to baptize with fire
english: This is why Christ is said to baptize with fire: because he poured out the grace of Christ on his holy disciples in the form of fiery tongues, or because of the punishing character of the fire to come.

title: The final baptism destroys evil but punishes endlessly
english: That final baptism is not saving but destructive of evil, for evil and sin no longer hold sway—yet it punishes endlessly.
